p.title: Three screens computed the 20-session HY spread change three ways (+32bp vs +34bp), and 매크로 read credit with its own thresholds
p.symptom: On 11/4 시장 상태's credit axis, the 매크로 credit chapter and 연결해서 보면's rates-credit pair quoted different 20-session high-yield changes for the same close (+32bp, +34bp). The 매크로 chapter said '크게 벌어졌습니다' and flipped at '3.5% 돌파' while 시장 상태 read the same spread as 중립.
p.root_cause: hyDelta20Bp (market-read) counted FRED observations, cross-readings looked the spread up by calendar date against the history's tnx window (19 sessions when FRED lags a day), and macro-chapters took the first and last observation of its own slice. macro-chapters also hardcoded +40bp/4.5%/+50bp/3.5% instead of RULES.credit and creditState.
p.fix: One reader, oasDelta20Bp(macroHistory, id, through), counts 20 US close sessions on FRED's own dates; hyDelta20Bp wraps it, cross-readings and the 매크로 chapter call it for HY, IG and CCC. The 매크로 chapter's state is creditState with RULES.credit (stressAtBp, widen5dBp, widen20dBp, stress20dPct/Multiple) and the record latch; its flip sentences print those values.
p.violated_rule: One number, one source (a figure shown on two screens is computed once)
p.prevention: {R}: the data-audit gate feeds one synthetic macro history (FRED one session behind the history) to all three readers and requires the same +45bp, 중립 on the 매크로 chapter, and the RULES.credit numbers in its flip.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-data-audit-contract-check.mjs — passes on the branch; on the 140ba22c tree the HY 20-session and 매크로 credit checks fail (+43bp pair, '크게 벌어졌습니다', '3.5% 돌파').

r.title: Credit spread changes and credit states come from market-read
r.rule: Every 20-session OAS change on screen is oasDelta20Bp (src/domain/briefing/market-read.js); every credit state is creditState with RULES.credit. No screen keeps its own credit thresholds.
